tasks.title: Secure FFmpeg render worker lifecycle
acceptance: Owned source asset registration and hash-verified staging
Durable render job state with lease fencing and crash recovery
Allowlisted FFmpeg binary and argv-only execution; no shell or arbitrary URLs
Bounded input size, clip count, CPU, memory and runtime
Audio mixing and ffprobe output validation
external_gates: Production filesystem isolation and resource limits
implemented_increment: Workspace-scoped private asset staging with server-side SHA-256, size limits, quarantine state and hash verification on access
Immutable normalized EDL v1 snapshots with database update/delete guards and workspace authorization
Idempotent timeline_render queue handoff carrying snapshot ID, digest and normalized EDL
Lease-fenced timeline worker with heartbeat, generation-token checks and review_pending completion
Shell-free FFmpeg audio-mix argv builder with bounded tracks, trims, fades, gain and limiter
Regression tests for asset isolation, snapshot immutability, queue handoff, worker transitions and audio argv validation
Lease-fenced checksum-verified render artifact adoption with workspace-scoped immutable records and atomic review_pending handoff
Worker integration and regression coverage for stale generation rejection, snapshot binding, private staging boundaries, byte limits and artifact tamper detection
Grace-period reconciliation of orphaned private artifact files after process crashes, serialized against active adoption
Bounded shell-free ffprobe validation helper with timeout, file/stream/duration limits and optional artifact-adoption metadata persistence
Concrete cancellable EDL v1 FFmpeg renderer for portrait video, timed title overlays and audio beds; source assets are re-authorized, staged and probed before render
Existing FFmpeg audio-mix builder connected to EDL audio clips with source in-points, timeline delays, gain, fades and limiter
Lease-loss cancellation, bounded process execution/output size, ffprobe output validation and staged MP4 cleanup on failed artifact adoption
Dedicated timeline_worker.py runtime registered with generation fencing and shutdown cancellation; Compose timeline-worker service shares private media, staging and artifact volume
Compose integration smoke now starts and health-checks the dedicated timeline render worker
Crash cleanup for abandoned staged MP4s and per-job working directories on timeline worker startup, with a grace period longer than maximum render timeout
FFmpeg and ffprobe input protocols restricted to local file and pipe; output profile checked for one H.264 1080x1920 video stream
Startup reconciliation of stale staging files, crashed per-job work directories and unindexed private artifact files
EDL audio track cap of eight and source-relative audio trim/fade ordering to preserve timing
remaining: Connect an actual malware scanner to the asset quarantine transition and fail closed when scanner health is unavailable
Pin FFmpeg/ffprobe builds and verify codec/filter compatibility on target Windows and isolated Linux runtimes
Run representative real-media renders plus process-tree crash/lease-loss tests using the pinned production binaries
Expose authenticated asset upload, render submission/status and review APIs for the browser editor
Enforce a host-level disk quota and retention policy for private source, staging and artifact storage
